Just going to copy and paste what I put in the Discord server.

"First part seems to be beating Blade in Realm of Discord (potentially with some other aspect? I think VGBM said he did that without getting the pre-req). Second looks like winning in Freedom Tower with the Freedom Five (not sure if specific variants are needed, I used base for them all and fought Ambuscade). Third...not sure if environment or team comp is important (F5 Legacy, Luminary, and TL Tachyon vs. Gloomweaver in Megalopolis), ended up getting all 18 devices out at one point, then used all three doomsday devices. I would like to note that on a whim, I used the Impulsion Beam without 15 cards in the trash (right after using the translocator properly), it didn't do anything, so I rewound and waited a round to have enough cards in the trash

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
The community has discovered the official unlock condition for Heroic Luminary.

First, defeat Baron Blade in the Realm of Discord without Luminary on the team. Then, win a game in Freedom Tower with the Freedom Five (any variants). Then, in a game in Megalopolis with Luminary on the team, use the power on each Doomsday Device while at least 15 cards are in Luminary's trash.
posts.raw:
The community has discovered the official unlock condition for Heroic Luminary.

First, defeat Baron Blade in the Realm of Discord without Luminary on the team. Then, win a game in Freedom Tower with the Freedom Five (any variants). Then, in a game in Megalopolis with Luminary on the team, use the power on each Doomsday Device while at least 15 cards are in Luminary's trash.

posts.name: “Mad Dog”
posts.cooked:
Super-Scientific Tachyon is also a good teammate for Luminary, as she usually can move a lot of cards into Luminary's discard pile with her innate power.  If by some chance her power lets Luminary play a pair of devices, well they are excellent fuel for "Sabre Battle Drone" cards and they get to the discard pile that way.

Though to be honest, Luminary can get a lot of cards into his discard pile on his own, especially if he can get "All According To Plan" into play and then plays "Timely Disruption" or "Dangerous Vision".  In my game, after getting set up Luminary (with help from Super-Scientific Tachyon and Omnitron-X and America's Greatest Legacy letting them use their power again) was getting 15+ cards into his discard pile every turn.

This was a fun variant unlock.  Looking forward to seeing the rest.
